dispute.claim_text: 34 km from Tampines to one-north. The route is 27 km, I have done this trip dozens of times. He said there was an accident but he went all the way down to Marina and along the AYE which is nowhere near where I would go. $43.41 is about $14 more than I normally pay.

counterparty_statement.text: PIE was blocked after Eunos, two lanes gone, LTA advisory ADV-20260716-007. There was also a breakdown on the CTE that night. I took ECP and MCE which was the only sensible way. I should not be penalised for an accident.

admissibility.notes: Trip record complete and causally ordered.

payload.optimal_route_source: routing-engine-v3.2 (LTA traffic snapshot 20:29; optimal is PIE westbound throughout)

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage. Shows the PIE exit at Bedok North Ave 4 ahead of the blocked segment and the rejoin on the AYE.
Driver announced the diversion; the rider acknowledged it.

payload.road_name: Pan Island Expressway (PIE) towards Tuas, after Eunos Link exit
payload.description: Multi-vehicle accident, 2 of 3 lanes blocked. Expect delays of 20-30 min.

issue_details.detail: The advisory geometry covers the CTE between Ang Mo Kio Ave 1 and the SLE. EV-GPS-00104 contains no fix inside that box at any point in the trip, so intersects_route is false and the advisory cannot bear on this route.
Submitted by the driver through the operator console rather than ingested from the LTA DataMall feed.

admissibility.notes: Present, in-window and internally coherent, but it describes a corridor this trip never enters. It overlaps the trip window, so POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered; the claim built on it is simply discarded on the merits.
